When do we do Whitman's "Song of Myself" 1-15 Who else is reading with us? I'm ready.
A few other follow ups:
David and Brigid point out that reality tv doesn't cost anything because it is, as it sounds, very low budget.
No writing , no special expertise or knowledge or research , no archival footage , no copyright clearance, no actors, no travel beyond the one location, certainly no clinton or woody allen or justice elena kagan or david brooks or Lena Dunham or even Professor New. That said, I think If were hiring the crew id do it
for less -- probably 1, 250,000 all in . But I haven't won 10 Emmys and David has . That has value too. As does Wgbh . But I'll be more prepared for the next conversation and want to be much more prepared for templeton, so thank you.
